skill.name: analytics
skill.description: Use when setting up marketing analytics, funnels, attribution, and event tracking so the agent follows the marketingskills playbook instead of producing generic marketing advice.
whenToUse: The user asks for help setting up marketing analytics, funnels, attribution, and event tracking
A marketing task needs product, audience, positioning, and channel context before execution
The agent should create a repeatable analytics workflow instead of a one-off generic answer
The work needs clear success metrics, deliverables, and next steps for a growth or GTM motion

keyConcepts.explanation: Core part of the analytics workflow; use it to keep the agent focused on concrete marketing inputs, decisions, and outputs instead of vague recommendations.
Every event should inform a decision Avoid vanity metrics Quality quantity of events
What do you need to know? What actions will you take based on this data? Work backwards to what you need to track
Naming conventions matter Establish patterns before implementing Document everything
Validate implementation Monitor for issues Clean data more data

apiReference.purpose: Install the analytics skill from coreyhaines31/marketingskills.

gotchas: Do not recommend dashboards before defining the decision each metric is supposed to support.
Event names and properties should be consistent before any attribution or funnel analysis is trusted.
Read product-marketing context first when present; otherwise the agent may ask repeated setup questions or make weak positioning assumptions.
Do not ship generic best practices without tying recommendations to the product, audience, channel, and conversion goal.
Separate strategy from execution: clarify the campaign decision before drafting assets or implementation steps.
